name: Northeast Forests and Rivers Fund
summary: Grants for forest habitat management, stream and riparian restoration, fish passage and hayfield management in New England and parts of New York, aimed at priority fish, turtle and bird species.

geography.label: New England and parts of New York

eligibility.rule: A 501(c) nonprofit, state, local or municipal government, Tribal entity or educational institution
Not a U.S. Federal government agency, business, unincorporated individual or international organization
Within the Long Island Sound and Connecticut River watershed, restore forests, grasslands or fish passage
In the listed upper Connecticut River watersheds, limit the project to fish passage or large wood additions

documents: Statement of Litigation, unless a government applicant
Board of Trustees or Directors list, or statement that none exists
GAAP audited financial statements, unless current valid information is already on file
IRS Form 990, unless current valid information is already on file
Single Audit, unless current valid information is already on file

status.quote: Northeast Forests and Rivers Fund 2025 Request for Proposals - CLOSED

deadline.quote: Full Proposal Due Date June 26, 2025, 11:59 PM EDT

applicant_types.quote: Eligible applicants include non-profit 501(c) organizations, state government agencies, local governments, municipal governments, Tribal governments and organizations, and educational institutions.

geography.quote: which includes all of Connecticut, Maine, Massachusetts, New Hampshire, Rhode Island and Vermont, as well as parts of New York.

access.quote: NFWF is soliciting proposals for the Northeast Forests and Rivers Fund (NFRF) to restore and sustain healthy rivers, forests and grasslands

amount.quote: Grant requests must range from $75,000 to $300,000.

co_finance_required.quote: A non-federal match valued at 50 percent of the total project cost (a 1:1 ratio of grant request to match) is preferred but not required.

window.quote: The program annually awards competitive grants

effort.quote: Full Proposal Due Date June 26, 2025, 11:59 PM EDT

eligibility.quote: Eligible applicants include non-profit 501(c) organizations, state government agencies, local governments, municipal governments, Tribal governments and organizations, and educational institutions.
Ineligible applicants include U.S. Federal government agencies, businesses, unincorporated individuals and international organizations.
However, within the Long Island Sound and Connecticut River watershed, NEFRF will only consider projects to sustain and restore healthy forests, grasslands and fish passage projects.
NEFRF will only fund fish passage and large wood additions in these watersheds.
